segments.name: container vessels segment
segments.description: Owns and operates container vessels chartered to liner companies on multi-year, fixed-rate time charter and bareboat charter agreements.
segments.evidence: The container vessels segment owns and operates container vessels which are primarily chartered on multi-year, fixed-rate time charter and bareboat charter agreements.

segments.name: drybulk vessels segment
segments.description: Owns and operates drybulk vessels providing drybulk commodity transportation services to charterers under time charter and voyage charter arrangements.
segments.evidence: The drybulk vessels segment owns and operates drybulk vessels to provide drybulk commodities transportation services.

revenueModel.text: Charterers, mainly liner companies and other cargo owners, pay charter hire for the use of the company's container and drybulk vessels under time, bareboat and voyage charters.
revenueModel.evidence: a container vessels segment, as a provider of worldwide marine transportation services through time charter and bareboat charter arrangements

changes.text: The company added a drybulk vessels segment in 2023 after acquiring drybulk vessels.
changes.evidence: Following the acquisition of the drybulk vessels in 2023, the Company operates in two separate segments in accordance with ASC 280
